note: Candidates held before publication for curatorial or source-evidence reasons. They are not publication candidates.

rejected.title: Silver pendant of coiled animal.
rejected.reason: Held: animal-style jewelry with no documented religious function.

rejected.title: Amber pendant, resembling a fetus.
rejected.reason: Held: fetus-like form is descriptive; no documented protective, fertility, or other religious function.

rejected.title: Hirvenpääkirves, Elk-headed stone axe KM45024:1
rejected.reason: Held: exceptional zoomorphic prestige object, but no documented ceremonial or religious function.

rejected.title: Puinen hirvenpääveistos
rejected.reason: Held: interpreted as a boat fitting; cosmological or ritual meaning is plausible but unproven.

rejected.title: Piekariņš - cirvītis. Mežītes pilskalns
rejected.reason: Held: miniature axe pendant, but an amuletic role is not established at object level.

rejected.title: Sasanian Relief Fragment with Boar Heads
rejected.reason: Held: the source misdates the Čāl Ṭarḵān fragment, later scholarship complicates its Sasanian classification, and boar imagery alone does not establish a devotional role.

rejected.title: Tetradrachm of Kanishka I with Nana
rejected.reason: Held: private-collection coin without institutional record or accession; not required for the narrower Iranian-deity comparison.

rejected.title: Tetradrachm of Kanishka I with Oado, God of Wind
rejected.reason: Held: private-collection coin without institutional record or accession; not required for the narrower Iranian-deity comparison.

rejected.title: Tetradrachm of Kanishka I with Oesho (Shiva)
rejected.reason: Held: private-collection coin without institutional record or accession; not required for the narrower Iranian-deity comparison.

rejected.title: Tetradrachm of Vima Kadphises with Shiva and Nandi
rejected.reason: Held: private-collection coin without institutional record or accession; not required for the narrower Iranian-deity comparison.

rejected.title: Ka’ba-ye Zartosht (Cube of Zoroaster)
rejected.reason: Held: the medieval name Kaʿba-ye Zardošt does not establish a Zoroastrian shrine, and the tower’s Achaemenid function remains disputed.

rejected.title: Achaemenid Winged Symbol (Modern Reconstruction)
rejected.reason: Held: modern noninstitutional digital reconstruction; identification of the Achaemenid winged symbol as specifically Faravahar or Ahura Mazda is debated.

rejected.title: Runestone Vettelandsteinen.
rejected.reason: Held after second-pass review: the secure text is a fragmentary commemoration; the supernatural-protection reading is speculative, so the object is not sufficiently religious for this batch.

rejected.title: Baba or Yam Mask
rejected.reason: Held after second-pass review: the institutional record documents a mask but gives no community, date, material, or ritual function.

rejected.title: Owl Mask
rejected.reason: Held after second-pass review: the object record documents the mask and materials but not a ritual or religious function.

rejected.title: Karhunhammasriipus - Bear Tooth Pendant
rejected.reason: Held after final curatorial review: the object record documents a pierced bear tooth from a domestic excavation; protective or magical meaning applies to the broader object type, not securely to this individual pendant.

rejected.title: Tinakansi - A Pewter Lid of a Salt Cellar
rejected.reason: Held after four-angle visual review: the downloadable scene includes two detached black-and-white photogrammetry calibration meshes floating above the pewter lid. Those meshes distort framing and would appear as unrelated objects in AR; the lid may be reconsidered after a documented mesh-only cleanup.

rejected.title: Stele del Dio Mitra - Mules
rejected.reason: Held after source and four-angle review: the model is an incomplete room scan of a mounted copy in Vipiteno Town Hall, including walls, door, furniture, floor and scan debris. The official record says the original stele is in Bolzano, so the current asset cannot truthfully stand in for that original.
